## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover changed credentials, parameters, routes, expressions, workflows, or package contents.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] No credentials, source content, workflow payloads, or personal data are included.
- [ ] The node remains declarative and adds no runtime dependencies.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe affected n8n versions, service-contract changes, migration needs, and rollback considerations. Write “None” where a category does not apply.
